title: Book a video appointment
intro: A video appointment is a scheduled conversation with a Harbor Help adviser using your phone, tablet or computer.
fact_title: What is the same for everyone
fact_body: A video appointment is not recorded. Harbor Help cannot access your device or its files.
privacy_body: We will not ask for your password or bank details. Use the support line if you need help before your appointment.
action: Choose an available time and book your video appointment.
support: Call the support line for practical help with booking or joining.
